testsuite.name: UC17 Lab Procedures
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 Admin has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Patient is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Patient has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has started documenting an office visit, including basic health metrics, for the patient [UC7 & UC8].

step.actions: admin: The administrator enters the LOINC code, Long Common Name, Component, and Property of the procedure. They press Add Procedure .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message shows if the procedure was entered correctly.

testcase.name: TC2 - Alternative Flow 1: Edit procedure
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 Admin has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Patient is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Patient has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has started documenting an office visit, including basic health metrics, for the patient [UC7 & UC8].

step.actions: admin: The administrator selects a procedure from the list of possible procedure, and presses Edit Procedure to edit the procedure. They can then change the LOINC code, common name, property, and description of the procedure. They press Submit .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message shows if the procedure was entered correctly.

The Patient has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has started documenting an office visit, including basic health metrics, for the patient [UC7 & UC8].

step.actions: admin: The administrator presses the Delete button associated with a LOINC procedure to delete it.

testcase.name: TC4 - Alternative Flow 3: Add procedure
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 Admin has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Patient is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Patient has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has started documenting an office visit, including basic health metrics, for the patient [UC7 & UC8].

step.actions: hcp: The HCP selects the correct procedure from the menu of procedure options labeled by their LOINC codes and descriptions. They enter the following additional information about the procedure: the priority from 1 to 4 (1 being highest), the lab tech who will perform the procedure, and any comments. They press the Add Procedure button.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message shows if the procedure was entered correctly.

testcase.name: TC5 - Alternative Flow 4: View assigned procedures
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 Admin has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Patient is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Patient has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has started documenting an office visit, including basic health metrics, for the patient [UC7 & UC8].

step.actions: admin: The lab tech selects to view their assigned procedures and data corresponding to the procedure. They can update the current status of the procedure. They can edit the current comment on the procedure, if they change the status to Completed. They can also select another lab tech, and assign the procedure to them.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message shows if the procedure was entered correctly.

testcase.name: TC6 - Alternative Flow 5: View an office
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 Admin has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Patient is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Patient has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . A Lab Tech is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The Lab Tech has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system . The HCP has started documenting an office visit, including basic health metrics, for the patient [UC7 & UC8].

step.actions: patient: The patient or HCP selects to view an office visit. They see all information pertaining to any procedures associated with the office visit, including LOINC code, priority, date, comment, and status. The patient cannot edit the information. The HCP can delete any procedure with a status of Assigned.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message shows if the procedure was entered correctly.
